Q1.) Integer p, q, r

Set p = 0, q = 2, r = 9

r = 7 + p

q = q + r

for (each r from 4 to 7)

p = (p + p) & q

if ((p + q) < (r - p) || 8 < p)

p = (p + 2) + q

Jump out of the loop

End if

End for

Print p + q

Q2.) #include<iostream> 

using namespace std;

int a = 3, b = 2, c = 5;

cout << result;

return 0;

}

Q3.) Integer value, n

Set value = 1, n = 45

while (value less than equal to n)

value = value << 1

end loop

Print value

Q4.) Predict the output of the following pseudocode.

Integer x, y, z

Set x = -2, y = 3, z = 1

if (x + (2 & 2) && y + (3 & 3) && z + (2 ^ 2))

x = x -2

y = x

Else

x = z

y = y ^ 2

End if

Print x + y + z

Q6. What is the output for p=15 and q=4.

value = p MOD q

p = q

q = value

End while

return p
